title: Realster
seoDescription: A Greater Boston real estate marketing site in Next.js with Motion reveals, Lenis scrolling, and a search-led hero.

modules.text:
A Greater Boston brokerage marketing site I built in Next.js 16 and TypeScript. The pitch is simple: every home on the books is listed by a Realster agent. You land on a split hero — headline and supporting copy on one side, a full-bleed villa plate on the other — with floating overlay cards for price, open-house status, and median asking. A search panel overlaps the hero: saved-search chips, Where / Price / Beds filters, and a direct CTA into the inventory.

Below that the page runs as a long product story: a homes carousel, private exclusives that never hit a portal, a book-a-viewing flow, neighborhood accordion with live counts, a dark numbers band (28 years, 6 offices, 1,140 closings), agent portraits, a three-step how-it-works tab panel, a filterable browse book, FAQ, press logos, and a contact form.

Motion is Motion (Framer): staggered reveals, soft rise/scale entrances, and reduced-motion fallbacks. Lenis owns the scroll. Tailwind v4 holds a warm white / charcoal / lilac token set with panel and card radii. The site is one composition of sections, not a multi-page MLS.

title: Folioport
seoDescription: A motion-first Vue 3 portfolio with GSAP choreography, Lenis scrolling, and a custom cursor.

modules.text:
A motion-first freelance folio I built in Vue 3 and TypeScript, so the site itself is the work sample. You land on an SVG wipe loader, then a split-text hero that scales down as you scroll. Services stack as sticky cards. Selected works keep a giant index that ticks as you pass each project, and the WebM previews only play and un-blur when they enter the viewport.

The motion layer is GSAP: ScrollTrigger, character-level text, elastic magnetic buttons, and a custom cursor that becomes a view chip over the work list. Tailwind v4 holds the flax-smoke palette and a fluid type scale. Lenis handles the scroll. A grain overlay sits over the page. There is also an infinite role marquee, a testimonial slider, and a full-viewport contact plate on a looping video with a Lottie globe.
